$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the gala pack composed with a 1970s disco supper-club birthday's content seed, re-registered in the disco register with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — the pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Disco birthday party
description: A milestone birthday thrown like a 1970s disco supper club: lacquer red, hot pink, and gold foil on black, the guest of honor in script under a mirror ball. The night's running order, the band and the midnight surprise, a "dazzle" dress code as fabric swatches, getting there with directions and a hotel block, a photo wall through the decades, song requests, and a reply card that delivers RSVPs straight to the hosts — with a live countdown computed from the party date. Flexes to anniversaries, retirements, and any big night.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed, merged over repobot.content.json at compose (the same overlay path as landing/theme — scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs applyPackOverlays). The guestlist domain is the gala's PRIVATE roster — who's invited, how many seats, the note that matters at the door — and deliberately seeds EMPTY: the roster is the owner's from day one, never demo data. No pack page renders it; it exists so the platform's Manage panel keeps the roster next to the RSVP inbox it pairs with (the catalog's gala-rsvp form).

theme.$comment: The disco register's brand overlay: the preset's lacquer red as the project brand, so app-side surfaces wear the same supper-club register as the party pages instead of the kernel default blue. mode dark opens the site in its native after-dark appearance, the supper club with the lights down. Values match the disco preset's own light/dark accents — the marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping them identical means the overlay re-brands the app without shifting the pages.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the disco register (black lacquer, lacquer red and hot pink with gold foil, high-contrast Didone caps, a swashy script, a mirror ball throwing sparkle across the room), and pages carries exactly the skeletons galaLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the seed names the guest of honor, so the hero is the invitation card and the details follow getting there, and the floor show, dress-code swatches, decades wall, and song requests appear because the seed fills them (tests/View/Gala/galaLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
